request.message:
Produce the complete Week 10 production digest for Nebula Drift (Vantage Nine Studios) as the whole document, replacing whatever is there. Use exactly this structure and content.

TITLE (Heading 1): Nebula Drift - Weekly Production Digest
STATUS LINE (bold, directly under the title): Week 10 · 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-15 · Phase: Vertical Slice
Below it, smaller grey text: Vantage Nine Studios · internal · standing document, edited in place every Monday

SECTION 'What changed' (Heading 2), as bullets, verbatim:
  - Cinematic camera rig handed to the animation team
  - Localisation pipeline stubbed for 6 languages
  - Vertical slice level greyboxed and playable start to finish

SECTION 'What is at risk' (Heading 2), as a bordered table with a shaded header row and alternating row shading, columns Risk / Owner / Area / Severity / Trend:
  | Crash rate above the cert threshold | Dev H. | QA | Medium | steady |
  | Publisher marketing beats not aligned with content lock | Marcus O. | Production | High | steady |
  | Streaming budget overrun on the Drift Belt | Yuki T. | Engineering | High | steady |

SECTION 'What is next' (Heading 2), as bullets, verbatim:
  - Get the slice in front of the publisher
  - Second external playtest, 20 players

  | Week 8 | 2026-02-23 to 2026-03-01 | Vertical slice level greyboxed and playable start to finish; Combat prototype merged to main behind a feature flag | Crash rate above the cert threshold; No accessibility sign-off for subtitle sizing |
  | Week 7 | 2026-02-16 to 2026-02-22 | Grapple cooldown retuned from 8s to 5s after playtest data; Cinematic camera rig handed to the animation team; Localisat | Save-game format still unversioned; Matchmaking backend untested above 5k CCU; Second comb |
  | Week 6 | 2026-02-09 to 2026-02-15 | Engine upgrade to 5.4 merged; build times down 31%; Art style exploration narrowed to two directions; Nav-mesh generatio | Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; Save-game format still unversioned |
  | Week 5 | 2026-02-02 to 2026-02-08 | Perforce to Git LFS migration completed for the audio depot; Grapple traversal prototype playable end to end on the test | Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; Outsourced character art slipping two we |
  | Week 4 | 2026-01-26 to 2026-02-01 | Nav-mesh generation for the Drift Belt sector; First pass on the Salvage economy spreadsheet | Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; Outsourced character art slipping two we |
  | Week 3 | 2026-01-19 to 2026-01-25 | Core loop pitch deck signed off by the publisher; Engine upgrade to 5.4 merged; build times down 31%; Art style explorat | Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; Outsourced character art slipping two we |
  | Week 2 | 2026-01-12 to 2026-01-18 | Hired a second combat designer (starts week 9); Perforce to Git LFS migration completed for the audio depot; Grapple tra | Save-game format still unversioned; Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; Outs |
  | Week 1 | 2026-01-05 to 2026-01-11 | Art style exploration narrowed to two directions; Nav-mesh generation for the Drift Belt sector | Save-game format still unversioned; Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller; Outs |
